scenarios: Fresh complete journeys permit exactly the next increment.
HTTP 200 plus 1400-ms journey latency blocks expansion.

tdd.controllerTestScope: lesson.test.cjs runs the actual lesson controller against a small in-memory DOM adapter. It does not substitute for the separately recorded real-browser checks.

red.cause: Minimal importable behavior stub returned 0% and no-op actions. The first genuine assertion expected 5 but received 0; failures were behavior assertions, not missing tooling or imports.

hardeningRed.cause: Additional malformed-sample test exposed '(observation.users ?? []).map is not a function'.
hardeningRed.fix: Treat non-array sample payloads as missing evidence, retain the unknown attempt, and block promotion.

incrementalRed.cause: The malformed fixture was absent; a null sample entry crashed rendering; invalid configuration escaped as a RangeError instead of a visible rejection.
incrementalRed.fix: Add the malformed fixture, tolerate null sample entries, and validate a prospective configuration before replacing the current rehearsal. Announce rejected configuration and clear its alert on explicit cleanup or valid restart.

verifiedBehaviors: Only one next cohort can be requested after fresh, complete, same-epoch journey evidence.
An HTTP 200 latency regression prevents the next increment and remains latched.
Authentication, state, completion and exactly-once effect failures block expansion.
Desired percentage does not manufacture actual destinations.
Missing or malformed samples, unknown outcomes, duplicate identities, incomplete windows and stale evidence cannot authorize expansion.
Successful unchanged v1 users and repeat observations of already-moved v2 users add no attempted migrations.
Failed and unknown attempted transitions remain in the denominator after later passing probes and rollback.
Rollback routing is requested, not assumed observed; a separate snapshot can observe all users on v1.
Both configurable four-stage plans reach the final synthetic stage without duplicate migration credit.
Restrictive CSP, local script references, labeled controls, a live result and honest scope are present in the portable assets.
Malformed payloads and null rows cannot crash cohort/trace rendering or authorize promotion.
Rejected stages/windows leave active observations and trace unchanged, and cannot reactivate a cleared rehearsal.
Explicit Clear removes local rows/history, disables five action controls, restores Start focus, and starts a separate attempt without leaked failures.

limitations: Browser verification covers the integrated browser, not a cross-browser or assistive-technology certification.

Selector click actionability timed out while the integrated page could be hidden. Actual pointer checks used native page.mouse clicks after geometry, hit-target and enabled checks, and verified isTrusted=true.
Malformed null-row and invalid select-value tests deliberately injected local synthetic data; they are not live routing or security-boundary tests.
All observations, destinations and user journeys are deterministic synthetic fixtures.
Twenty correlated invented users and a simulated clock establish no 99.999% reliability, native routing, production capacity, authentication enforcement or recovery guarantee.
v1 is retained; no real drain, retirement, rollback execution or external business effect is measured.
No framework, runtime/auth/hosting contract, scaffold/deploy approval or cloud execution is authorized.
B-S003 and full D-S003/source acceptance remain unfulfilled.
Failed/unknown transitions are deliberately conservative and cannot be retroactively repaired by a later passing probe; a new rehearsal is a separate attempt.
pathNormalization: Commands and committed evidence use repository-relative paths; private absolute user paths are omitted. The publication receipt/controller result provides the incremental SHA and tag rather than a self-referential commit field.
